description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for detailed product information, including localized descriptions, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ProductDetailResponse
classes.description: Record representing detailed information about a product, including identification, SKU, type, availability, localized descriptions, and timestamps.

classes.name: LocalizedText
classes.description: Nested record within ProductDetailResponse that encapsulates localized text details, such as language id, display name, description, and SEO-friendly URL.
